vitaldrug_p8_3.issue: calque: 'approaching' rendered as a noun / dropped 'very'
vitaldrug_p8_3.why: EN: "a place where there is an engulf into a CPAZ, and approaching is also a CP" (a CP is approaching the area, verb). FA: "و نزدیک شدنش هم یک CP است" literally says "its approaching is also a CP", which is a calque no Persian trader would use and loses the sense that a CP is coming towards the level. Also EN "very big LS kinks" became "کینک‌های بزرگ LS", dropping the intensifier "very".
